fields.statement: Verifier at a671d8aa: ran `go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run 'DaemonEvents' -count=1 -v`; TestDaemonEventsRef PASS. The test runs a recording event command (cat >> file) over moves of a change set opened with a ref containing quotes, spaces, & and non-ASCII (proposed, accepted) and one without (proposed); it decodes each payload and checks the first's ref equals the input verbatim and the second's has no ref key, with 2 and 1 payloads respectively. Diff read: lifecycleEvent gains `Ref string json:"ref,omitempty"`, set in daemonFold from the folded change set's c.Open.Ref for every lifecycle move in eventNames, so all moves (incl. rejected/withdrawn/superseded/landed/reopened) share the one path. The ref exists only on the open body, so it is the same on every move. gofmt and go vet are clean on internal/api.
